statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead, privacy lead, CPNI certifying officer, and CALEA senior officer in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with periodic outside review
CALEA policies filed through CEFS; intercepts only with legal and carrier authorization; records with 1.20004 fields
Annual CPNI certification by March 1 with an accurate, evidence-based statement
Sanctions, including for CPNI misuse
Written, time-limited exceptions
No CPNI or subscriber data to a vendor without confidentiality, security, and breach notice terms
Vendor list doubles as the record of third-party access to CPNI
Annual billing vendor SOC 2 review; VoIP provider report or questionnaire
Consultant uses named VPN account in owner-approved sessions
Named accounts; no shared accounts
MFA on every service that offers it
Unique passphrases in a password manager; unique device passwords; defaults changed before service
Same-day removal; quarterly account review
Device management only from the management VLAN and VPN
Monthly review of SaaS sign-in histories and router logs
Call detail by phone only with a compliant password, or sent to the address or number of record
Online CPNI only after compliant portal sign-in; AI assistant limited to signed-in sessions; account change notices
Sealed emergency access envelope
Three-level classification; whole account record treated as Restricted
CPNI used only for the home phone service; no marketing; approval status none
CDR exports imported directly or deleted; never emailed
Full-disk encryption on devices holding Restricted data
Weekly automatic router and switch configuration copy
Security records kept at least 2 years
Quarterly firmware review; critical updates within 30 days; advisories; monthly port check
Change log for router and switch; radio settings from templates
Encrypted VoIP signaling and media on ATAs
AI tools: no customer data except the assessed assistant; reassessment before new features
Annual CPNI and security training
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
CPNI breach notice to USSS and FBI within 7 business days; hold on customer notice
CPNI breach record kept 2 years
CALEA compromise and unlawful surveillance report
911 center outage contact confirmed yearly; thresholds rechecked
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Standby restore agreement with the network consultant
Spare router with current configuration; restore test twice a year
